query: select clock_timestamp() as observed_at, n.nspname, p.proname, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as args, encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex') as sha256, pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) as owner, p.proacl::text as acl, p.proconfig, p.prosecdef, p.provolatile, p.prokind, p.proparallel, p.proleakproof from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='clued_control' and p.proname in ('effective_execution_binding','execution_transition','commit_gate_result','reserve_gate') order by p.proname
